Name: Linda
Dialog: (in the Kitchen/Dining Room) What a beautiful summer day. Do you boys have anything exciting planned?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're either gonna make this nuclear-powered submarine or this incredible shrinking ray. But for some reason, Ferb and I can't seem to make up our minds.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I've made up my mind. (hugs them) You two have the most wonderful imaginations.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's real, you know.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What's real, dear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The submarine? The shrinking ray? They're really gonna build that stuff.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walks up) Well, actually we haven't (Candace pushes him away with her spoon) decided yet--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking fast) Anyway, when I try to bust them, everything will just magically disappear. Always happens. you'll see. Well, you won't see. I'll see, trust me.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Oblivious) As usual, the imagination in this room is astounding! (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Answers her video phone as it rings; With the spoon in her mouth) Hello?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (On phone) Hi, Candace.  It's Jeremy. I was wondering if you wanted to go for a walk today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (spits out her cereal then daintily wipes her mouth with a napkin) I would very much enjoy going for a walk. Wherever shall we go?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: To my uncle's restaurant?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! That sounds do-able! Why not pick me up around noon? Okay! Goodbye. (hangs up, dials Stacy) Oh, my gosh! Guess who just called and asked me out on a date!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Who!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh! (2x)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Hold on! Let's conference in Jenny!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay! (dials) Ahh!

Name: Stacy/Jenny
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh! (4x)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (overlapping) Let's go outside!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (The boys now sit under their tree) Submarine, shrinking ray. I just can't make up my mind!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) What'cha doooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (walks up with her dog) Hi, Phineas! You remember Pinky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Close up of the dog) Oh, yeah! Hi, Pinky!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Showing her Fireside sash) Hey, check out my new sash! It's got all my accomplishment patches sewn onto it. (holds aforesaid sash in front of him) See?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. That looks totally irreplaceable. (Pinky jumps up and swallows Isabella's sash.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Pinky, I need that sash for a Fireside Girls ceremony this afternoon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Isabella, we'll get your sash back.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But how? It's in Pinky's stomach!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Ferb holds up the blueprints.) Hmm... (realizing) Ferb, you're a genius! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, thanks for coming. It's Dr. Doofenshmirtz. He's been hiding out in the old abandoned vacuum cleaner factory. You know, that building across town with the giant vacuum cleaner on top? Man, I can't believe that place closed. I blame the Internet. (pause) Your mission, Agent P, is to find out what Doofenshmirtz is up to and then stop him.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, how are we gonna retrieve my sash?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here. Ferb made this multimedia presentation. (Shows the presentation) We shrink the sub down with Ferb and me in it, and put it in Pinky's dog food. After he eats us, the sub extrudes two mechanical arms, which fold up the sash to microscopic size and pull it into the sash storage unit. Finally, we pilot up into the mouth and have Pinky drool us out. Easy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gross, but cool! But Pinky will eat anything but dog food. He likes grilled cheese sandwiches. (Pinky pants excitedly)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a problem. You make the sandwich. We'll make the sub. (Ferb imitates Pinky's excited panting)

Name: Man
Dialog: (Some time Later...) Okay. A subatomic shrinking module, hydrostatic ballast tank, and a case of AA batteries. Sign here, please.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aren't you wondering if we're a little young to be building a submarine?

Name: Man
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. We get that a lot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (One Build-Up later...; walks in with Pinky) One grilled cheese sandwich, hot off the- Oh, cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. You're just in time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys amaze me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: When we're inside, we'll activate the shrinkage. You take care of the rest.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Check it out, Pinky, your favorite.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (engine whirring) Ready? (After a blue button is pushed, the submarine shrinks then lands into the grilled cheese sandwich.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It worked! All right, Pinky-Winky, time for some cheesy-weesy! (A black cat yowls and Pinky's ears perks up. The cat hisses then runs off with a barking Pinky in pursuit.; While running after Pinky) No, Pinky! Chasing the cat is so cliche! You're better than that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after opening the door to the garage) Listen up! Jeremy will be here any second and I wanna tell you... (notices Isabella's sandwich) Ooh, grilled cheese, my favorite. Might as well eat now, so I don't look like a pig on my date.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? I... You know, we always do the same thing. I have a scheme, you try to stop me, I trap you, I tell you my scheme, you escape, then we fight, and I'm defeated. Let's mix it up a little. Let me tell you what. I will tell you my scheme first and then I will trap you! What do you say, huh? Yes, this is much better. Okay, so here it is. The Make-Up-Your-Mind-inator! (chuckles) You know, when you're waiting to order a pizza and the person in front of you can't decide on a topping. Ohh, I hate that! I hate it! (mumbles) I will destroy anyone who can't make up their mind! (Echoes) Destroy anyone who can't make up their mind!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (in a brief flashback) Ferb and I can't seem to make up our minds. (Perry becomes enraged)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Should I go with Make-Up-Your-Mind-inator? Or is that too-on-the-nose? It's funny. Now I can't make up my mind. Oof! (Perry attacks Doofenshmirtz in a frenzy and cuffs him to a wall) Perry the Platypus! What are... Well, I--I did not see that coming. (Perry clamps the other handcuff onto a pipe) Calling headquarters, huh? Hmm. Yes, you—you didn't even give me a chance to trap you. (Camera pans to a giant snow globe, with the S'winter song) See? I was going to put you in that giant snow globe over there, and... (Camera switches back to him) now I have to return it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! What's wrong? Oh! You caught Doofenshmirtz, huh? That's weird. Usually he traps you, then you escape and then...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We mixed it up a little!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hang tight, Agent P. Backup is on the way. I mean, it would be, if we had some. Uh, I'm gonna make some calls.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. (chewing noisily) This is good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It worked! Pinky's chewing! Prepare for swallowing! (He and Ferb buckle their seatbelts)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (The front Doorbell rings; Gasps) Jeremy's here! (Gulps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (inside...) Whoa! Whaah! (Sonar pinging) Wow. Pinky's neck is really long.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (the front door opens) Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Belches) Heh heh. Heh. Excuse me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did it, Ferb! We're inside Pinky. How about a little road trip music?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now to find that sash. Hey, tacos! Ah, tacos. You know who makes the best tacos? Mom, These kind of remind me of the ones we had... (realizing) ...for dinner last night. Hey, Pinky didn't have dinner with us. Wait a minute! Candace's favorite cereal? (His cell phone rings.) Hello?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in the garage) Phineas, where are you? Pinky ran away, and when I came back, the sandwich was gone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, let me call you back. (hangs up, to Ferb) Yeah, we're inside Candace's stomach.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's creepy on so many levels.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Looking at his watch) This backup of yours is taking forever. (Points to the left while Perry gets up and stretches) I have a travel chess set in my bag over there. (Perry walks in the opposite direction) Do you play chess? (Still pointing to the left) Over there, actually. (Perry opens the bag to the right, only get trapped by a magnet belt) Ha ha ha ha! I tricked you, Perry the Platypus! (Takes a hairpin from his hair then uses it to pick the lock on the handcuff) Do you like my Any-Flat-Surface-Magnet-Belt? It sticks to any flat surface. Hee hee hee hee. Guess what? There's no travel chess set in this bag, either. (gets trapped by the other magnet belt) There was one of these in both bags, so whichever one you chose, you would be stuck. Just like I'm... stuck... right now. What, uh... wh-what time is that backup getting here again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, here we are. Let's tap into Candace's nerve center so we can see what she sees.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ears... (another claw grabs another tendril, now the screen displays her eyes are hooked up.) Eyes... (the monitor shows a visual of Jeremy from Candace's view) Look, we're getting an image. She's on her date with Jeremy. (they are at the Danville Park.) That means we're on a date with Jeremy.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Again, creepy on so many levels.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (her video phone rings) Oh, excuse me. My phone is ringing. Hello?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on phone) Candace, I know this sounds weird, but Ferb and I shrunk down in a submarine. We were in that sandwich you ate, and now we're in your stomach.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles nervously) Are you wacko? Don't call me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! We can prove it! (to Ferb) How do we prove it? (Ferb pulls up a feather duster to tickle Candace's insides)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughing) Whoo! Yeah! (whispering harshly) What is going on?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, monkey bars. Do you still get sick when you hang upside down?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Why?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Candace. We have to help Isabella. So, arms and legs!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh heh. Heh. Never better. (Starts walking like a robot as Phineas and Ferb control her limbs) Never better! (straining) Phineas, I'm going to... (About to vomit)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! All right! Yeah! What happened?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you sure you're okay? (Candace gulps) Come on, my uncle's restaurant is right over here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Any other ideas? (Ferb pulls out the feather duster again and tickles the inside of Candace's throat)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Coughs, clears throat) I have a tickle in my throat. (Clearing throat)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Stay right here. I'm gonna go get some water. (Candace coughs out the sub, it returns to normal size and Phineas and Ferb come out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Candace's video phone rings; on the phone) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb built a shrinking submarine!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on the phone) Candace, I'll see it later. Right now, I have to swing by Jeremy's uncle's restaurant and pick up some sandwiches for your father.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perfect!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He leaves it through a boarded-up window.) Farewell, Perry the Platypus! (Agent P follows after him. The two then uses the magnet belts to reach the top of the giant vacuum cleaner.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom?! Submarine, submarine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screaming; falls into the submarine)

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? It's a submarine!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (facepalms) Urrrg!

Name: Linda
Dialog: So... (walks away) imaginative.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (walks over with Pinky) Hey, I been lookin' everywhere for you guys! Pinky threw up and I got my sash back!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Gross, but cool. Speaking of pets... (Perry chatters) Where ya been, Perry?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I have a surprise for you. Check it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sandwich menu? "The Candace Special"? (touched) Oh, you had a sandwich named after me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Grilled cheese, 'cause I know it's your favorite.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Shall we eat inside?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is the end of a perfect day. My very own sandwich! I can't wait to try it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (inside Pinky) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? Where am I? Oh, it's all gastrointestiney in here. Hmm... Brain. (gasps) I'm inside a dog! (Pinky wakes up in surprise then glares) Perfect. Now I can pee all over the Tri-State Area! Ha ha ha ha ha! (sighs) Oh, what am I doing with my life?
